observations: In Table 1, TQA column shows two values separated by '/', e.g., '55.2/66.1', likely indicating standard test / TQA-Wiki test scores per the table title.

In Table 2, the first row (id: Table_2_Row_1) appears to be a header row mapping column names to sub-metrics (e.g., 'Jeopardy' column corresponds to 'B-1' metric), not a data row; however, per instruction to include all discernible data rows, it is retained as-is with literal values from the table.
Table 2 includes an asterisked value '49.8*' and '49.9*', which per notes refer to use of gold context/evidence.
The underlining of best model without gold access is not rendered in plain text; no model is explicitly underlined in the provided text, so no inference is made about which entry is underlined.
uncertainties: The exact meaning of '-' in Table 1 (e.g., T5-11B TQA column) is not specified beyond what's stated in the title; it may indicate missing or not reported value.

In Table 2, the first row (Jeopardy/B-1/QB-1/R-1/B-1/Label Acc.) is ambiguous: it may be a meta-header rather than a model row. However, since the prompt requires transcribing all discernible data rows literally, it is included as a row with those string values.

The note '*Uses gold context/evidence' applies to SotA entries (49.8*, 49.9*, 76.8), but it is unclear whether 92.2* (in the same row) also carries the asterisk in original source — in provided text, '92.2*' appears in the SotA row's Label Acc. cell, so it is transcribed as '92.2*'.

In Table 2, the 'Label Acc.' column for SotA row contains '92.2*', but the preceding cells are '49.8*', '49.9*', '76.8' — the '76.8' lacks asterisk while '92.2*' has one; this is preserved as literal.
